stem: During a shift, patient acuity and team workload change unexpectedly. The nursing team holds a brief huddle. What is the main purpose of this TeamSTEPPS tool?

options.A: Establish the initial team, roles, goals, and care plan before the work period begins.
options.B: Review completed team performance after an event to identify lessons and future improvements.
options.C: Verify that one specific message was received and understood through closed-loop communication.
options.D: Re-establish situational awareness, discuss emerging issues, and adjust the existing care plan or workload as needed.

rationale: AHRQ TeamSTEPPS defines a huddle as an ad hoc meeting used to re-establish or affirm situational awareness, reinforce the current plan, and assess whether the plan or workload needs to be adjusted as conditions change. Therefore D is correct. A describes a brief, B describes a debrief, and C describes a check-back.
educational_objective: Use a TeamSTEPPS huddle during ongoing care when changing patient or team conditions require renewed situational awareness and possible adjustment of the care plan or workload.
source_organization: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ)
source_document_title: TeamSTEPPS 3.0 — Monitoring and Modifying the Plan: Huddle; Team Leadership Overview
source_version_date: Huddle and Team Leadership pages last reviewed May 2023; current TeamSTEPPS 3.0 curriculum rechecked 2026-08-17
source_locator: Monitoring and Modifying the Plan: Huddle — communicates adjustments to an existing care plan when patient condition, team membership, or workload changes; Team Leadership Overview > Huddle — ad hoc meeting to re-establish situational awareness, reinforce the plan, or assess need to augment/adjust
source_claim_supported: A TeamSTEPPS huddle is an ad hoc replanning tool used during ongoing care to restore situational awareness, review emerging issues, and adjust an existing plan or workload when conditions change.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
blueprint_locator: Management of Care, printed p.7/PDF p.11: Collaborate with members of the interprofessional health care team to facilitate client care; Establish priorities for client care; Participate in client care coordination
blueprint_topic: Management of Care — team replanning and workload coordination
correction_summary: Retained the huddle construct but replaced weak straw-man alternatives with three real TeamSTEPPS tools/functions: brief, debrief, and check-back. The final stem adds changing acuity/workload to make the replanning indication concrete. Difficulty reduced from hard to easy.
